An '''R5-series astromech droid''' accompanied the elite [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] fighting force [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] on a [[Mission to Mos Eisley (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to rescue [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] Rebel [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] secretly placed a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] on the [[R5-series astromech droid|R5 unit]], which allowed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to track the Rebels back to their base on [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] following the mission.
